work.en: Authentic Epistles (Romans, 1-2 Corinthians, Galatians, Philippians, 1 Thessalonians, Philemon)
work.es: Epístolas Auténticas (Romanos, 1-2 Corintios, Gálatas, Filipenses, 1 Tesalonicenses, Filemón)

notes.en: Direct primary sources written by Paul himself. Universally accepted as authentic by scholars.
notes.es: Fuentes primarias directas escritas por el propio Pablo. Universalmente aceptadas como auténticas por los estudiosos.

work.es: La Guerra de los Judíos (Bellum Judaicum)

notes.en: Eyewitness account of the Jewish-Roman War and destruction of Jerusalem. Josephus was present during the siege.
notes.es: Relato de testigo presencial de la Guerra Judeo-Romana y la destrucción de Jerusalén. Josefo estuvo presente durante el asedio.

citation_info.en: Book 6, Chapters 4-5: Detailed description of the siege and destruction of the Temple. Book 6, Chapter 5, Section 1: 'the sanctuary was burned' in the month of August
citation_info.es: Libro 6, Capítulos 4-5: Descripción detallada del asedio y destrucción del Templo. Libro 6, Capítulo 5, Sección 1: 'el santuario fue quemado' en el mes de agosto

notes.en: Historical account from Creation to the outbreak of the Jewish-Roman War. Includes the Testimonium Flavianum about Jesus (controversial authenticity).
notes.es: Relato histórico desde la Creación hasta el estallido de la Guerra Judeo-Romana. Incluye el Testimonium Flavianum sobre Jesús (autenticidad controvertida).

citation_info.en: Book 18, Chapter 3, Section 3: 'At this time there appeared Jesus, a wise man' (Testimonium Flavianum). Book 20, Chapter 9, Section 1: Reference to 'James, brother of Jesus who was called Christ'
citation_info.es: Libro 18, Capítulo 3, Sección 3: 'En este tiempo apareció Jesús, un hombre sabio' (Testimonium Flavianum). Libro 20, Capítulo 9, Sección 1: Referencia a 'Santiago, hermano de Jesús llamado Cristo'

sources.notes: Roman historian's account of Nero's persecution. Independent confirmation of Jesus's execution under Pontius Pilate.
sources.citation_info: Book 15, Chapter 44: 'Christus, from whom the name had its origin, suffered the extreme penalty during the reign of Tiberius at the hands of one of our procurators, Pontius Pilatus'

sources.notes: Governor's correspondence with Emperor Trajan about Christians. Describes early Christian worship practices.
sources.citation_info: Book 10, Letter 96: Correspondence with Emperor Trajan asking how to handle Christians in Bithynia. Describes Christians meeting before dawn, singing hymns to Christ 'as to a god'

work.es: Vida de los Doce Césares (De Vita Caesarum)

notes.en: Biographies of Julius Caesar through Domitian. Contains brief reference to Claudius expelling Jews from Rome.
notes.es: Biografías desde Julio César hasta Domiciano. Contiene breve referencia a Claudio expulsando judíos de Roma.

citation_info.en: Life of Claudius 25.4: 'Since the Jews constantly made disturbances at the instigation of Chrestus, he expelled them from Rome'
citation_info.es: Vida de Claudio 25.4: 'Como los judíos causaban disturbios constantemente a instigación de Cresto, los expulsó de Roma'

notes.en: Continuation of Luke's Gospel narrating early church history. Historical reliability debated, especially regarding Paul's journeys.
notes.es: Continuación del Evangelio de Lucas narrando la historia de la iglesia primitiva. Fiabilidad histórica debatida, especialmente sobre los viajes de Pablo.

citation_info.en: Chapter 15: Jerusalem Council. Chapter 18:2: Aquila and Priscilla expelled from Rome by Claudius. Chapters 13-28: Paul's missionary journeys and arrest
citation_info.es: Capítulo 15: Concilio de Jerusalén. Capítulo 18:2: Aquila y Priscila expulsados de Roma por Claudio. Capítulos 13-28: Viajes misioneros de Pablo y arresto

sources.notes: Earliest Gospel narratives. Mark written c. 70, Matthew and Luke c. 80-90, using Mark as source.
sources.citation_info: Mark 13:1-2, 14-23: Prophecy of Temple destruction. Mark 14-15: Passion narrative. Matthew 27, Luke 23: Trial and crucifixion accounts with variations

sources.notes: Latest canonical Gospel with distinct theological perspective and unique material.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 1:1-18: Logos prologue. Chapters 18-19: Passion narrative with unique details (Pilate dialogue). Chapter 20:28: 'My Lord and my God' - high Christology

work.en: The New Testament: A Historical Introduction to the Early Christian Writings
work.es: El Nuevo Testamento: Una Introducción Histórica a los Escritos Cristianos Primitivos

notes.en: Standard academic textbook on New Testament historical-critical scholarship.
notes.es: Libro de texto académico estándar sobre la erudición histórico-crítica del Nuevo Testamento.

citation_info.en: Chapter 10 (pp. 139-157): Paul's life and letters. Chapter 15 (pp. 222-239): Gospel of Mark composition and dating. Chapter 17 (pp. 260-278): Gospel of John. See pp. 229-231 for dating Mark to post-70 CE
citation_info.es: Chapter 10 (pp. 139-157): Paul's life and letters. Chapter 15 (pp. 222-239): Gospel of Mark composition and dating. Chapter 17 (pp. 260-278): Gospel of John. See pp. 229-231 for dating Mark to post-70 CE

sources.work: Did Jesus Exist? The Historical Argument for Jesus of Nazareth
sources.notes: Scholarly defense of Jesus's historicity against mythicism. Examines all ancient sources.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 2 (pp. 43-94): 'Non-Christian Sources for the Life of Jesus' covers Tacitus, Pliny, Josephus. Chapter 3 (pp. 95-142): Paul as earliest witness. Chapter 4 (pp. 143-205): Gospel sources and dating

sources.notes: Influential historical reconstruction by Arts and Sciences Professor of Religion at Duke University.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 10 (pp. 249-269): 'The Last Days in Jerusalem' covers the crucifixion. Chapter 11 (pp. 270-281): discusses the evidence for Jesus's death. See also pp. 10-11 for methodology on historical sources

sources.notes: Groundbreaking work on Paul's theology and relationship to Judaism. Changed scholarly understanding of 'New Perspective on Paul'.
sources.citation_info: Part III (pp. 431-556): 'Paul' - detailed analysis of Pauline theology. Chapter on 'The Solution and the Plight' (pp. 474-497) is particularly influential

sources.work: Jesus and the Eyewitnesses: The Gospels as Eyewitness Testimony
sources.notes: Argues for Gospel reliability based on eyewitness testimony patterns. Bauckham is Professor Emeritus at University of St Andrews.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 2 (pp. 39-66): 'Eyewitness Testimony and Gospel Traditions'. Chapter 18 (pp. 471-508): 'The Johannine Community'

sources.work: The New Testament and the People of God
sources.notes: First volume of Christian Origins series. Wright is former Bishop of Durham and Research Professor at St Mary's College.
sources.citation_info: Part II (pp. 145-338): 'Tools for the Task' - methodology for historical study. Part III (pp. 339-443): 'First-Century Judaism within the Greco-Roman World'

work.en: The Resurrection of the Son of God
work.es: La Resurrección del Hijo de Dios

notes.en: Defends historicity of bodily resurrection within Jewish context of Second Temple Judaism.
notes.es: Defiende la historicidad de la resurrección corporal dentro del contexto judío del Judaísmo del Segundo Templo.

citation_info.en: Part III (pp. 319-552): 'The Resurrection of Jesus' - historical argument. Chapter 18 (pp. 587-683): 'Easter and History'
citation_info.es: Part III (pp. 319-552): 'The Resurrection of Jesus' - historical argument. Chapter 18 (pp. 587-683): 'Easter and History'

sources.work: Jesus Remembered (Christianity in the Making, Vol. 1)
sources.notes: Examines oral tradition and memory in Gospel formation. Dunn is Emeritus Lightfoot Professor at Durham University.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 8 (pp. 239-280): 'The Characteristic Jesus' - oral tradition analysis. Chapter 18 (pp. 775-876): 'Remember Jesus' - passion narrative

sources.work: The Historical Jesus: The Life of a Mediterranean Jewish Peasant
sources.notes: Influential Jesus Seminar scholar's reconstruction. Crossan is Professor Emeritus at DePaul University.
sources.citation_info: Part III (pp. 225-394): 'Brokerless Kingdom' - Jesus's social program. Chapter 17 (pp. 354-394): 'Open Healing' discusses crucifixion

sources.work: A Marginal Jew: Rethinking the Historical Jesus (5 volumes)
sources.notes: Comprehensive scholarly series examining Jesus historically. Meier is Professor Emeritus at Notre Dame.
sources.citation_info: Volume 1, Chapter 3 (pp. 68-111): 'Jesus in Josephus'. Volume 1, Chapter 5 (pp. 140-166): 'Jesus in the Pagan Sources'. Volume 1, Chapter 11: 'The Death of Jesus'

sources.work: The Four Gospels and the One Gospel of Jesus Christ
sources.notes: Leading German scholar on Gospel origins and early Christianity. Hengel taught at Tübingen University.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 2 (pp. 64-115): 'The Titles of the Gospels and the Gospel of Mark'. Chapter 3 (pp. 116-168): 'Problems of Priority and Date'

sources.work: Constructing Jesus: Memory, Imagination, and History
sources.notes: Methodological approach to historical Jesus research. Allison is Professor of New Testament at Princeton Theological Seminary.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 1 (pp. 1-59): 'Problems and Methods' - historiographical approach. Chapter 10 (pp. 397-424): 'Conclusion: Jesus in the Gospels'

notes.en: Magisterial two-volume commentary on Passion narratives across all four Gospels.
notes.es: Comentario magisterial de dos volúmenes sobre las narrativas de la Pasión en los cuatro Evangelios.

citation_info.en: Volume 1: covers Mark 14:1-15:47, Matthew 26:1-27:66. Volume 2: covers Luke 22:1-23:56, John 18:1-19:42. See especially Vol. 1, pp. 373-397 on the historicity of the Jewish trial; Vol. 2, pp. 863-877 on crucifixion practices
citation_info.es: Volume 1: covers Mark 14:1-15:47, Matthew 26:1-27:66. Volume 2: covers Luke 22:1-23:56, John 18:1-19:42. See especially Vol. 1, pp. 373-397 on the historicity of the Jewish trial; Vol. 2, pp. 863-877 on crucifixion practices

sources.work: Lord Jesus Christ: Devotion to Jesus in Earliest Christianity
sources.notes: Examines origins of Christology and worship of Jesus. Hurtado was Professor Emeritus at University of Edinburgh.
sources.citation_info: Chapter 2 (pp. 64-153): 'Early Pauline Christianity' - worship practices. Chapter 7 (pp. 619-649): 'The Fourth Gospel' - Johannine Christology
